rules.statement: The court has the inherent power to grant an interim stay order restraining an administrative authority from proceeding with a particular course of action, pending determination of an application where final relief will otherwise be rendered nugatory.
rules.supporting_quote: "Considering the matters that have been pleaded in the petition, in particular with regard to the environmental impact of the proposed lease of state land adjacent to the Kandalama tank, we are of the view that the 2nd respondent should be restrained, pending the determination of this application from executing a lease of that land without complying with Regulation 21 (2)."

meta.parties: Environmental Foundation Ltd. v. The Land Commissioner and Others
